subject: [PATCH v4 12/21] ext2: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch converts the ext2 file system's iomap operations to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using a macro that wraps the iomap_iter_next helper. This change does not introduce any functional changes and is part of a larger series of patches. The conversion is done in the inode.c file, where the ext2_iomap_ops structure is updated to point to the new ->iomap_next() callback.
